capabilities.notice: Enabled capability does not imply selected at every origin; see tool counts.

estimate_limit: Serial origin latency only; excludes startup, file hashing, and environment changes. Not an accuracy estimate.
iteration_semantics: Candidate comparison rounds and optional LLM revisions are counted from explicit trace lists; missing legacy fields count as zero.
tool_count_semantics: Counts trace tool attempts, including recorded errors; protocol-required coverage is not evidence of LLM benefit.
